verdict.rationale: Elastic markets itself as a platform for building AI apps and agents, so consuming tools from external MCP servers is a fair question to ask of it. However, the pack has no evidence that Elasticsearch can act as an MCP client or call tools from MCP servers. The only MCP evidence is an official MCP server that exposes Elasticsearch to other agents. That is the server role, a different story, and earns no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
